name: (1M UPDATE👑) Sonic.EXE: Stay Alive (Prototype)
desc:
«Sonic.Exe: Stay Alive» - is a game, where you have to be a survivor, or be the one to kill those survivors. Try to stay alive as long as you can.🔪

◄😇If you're a survivor - your tasks are to explore different locations and maps, find fellow survivors just like you and not get into the trouble! Make sure to find a character with which, you'll live the longest.

◄😈If you are a killer - your task is catch all of the survivors! Choose a killer, and dont ever have a mercy on a survivor!

💍While you are playing, your Rings count is increasing. For Rings you can buy different skins for different survivors/killers, though some of skins can only be obtained from having a specific badge.

◥Have a nice time in Sonic.Exe: Stay Alive!!◤ (translated by qw0zor :p)
